care_animals: I care for dogs, cats, rabbits and rodents.
hours: Hours: by appointment, also in the evenings and weekends
intro: Some of the health and medical care that can be done in an animal clinic can also be done at home. Veterinarian Oleg Melentev makes home visits in the Kotka-Hamina region. By agreement also further away. Book an appointment and ask for a veterinarian to come home 12:00-21:00. No night duty. Price examples can be found on the price list.
education: Veterinarian Oleg Melentev graduated on 28.6.1993 with a degree in veterinary medicine in Russia at the Saint Petersburg Veterinary Institute. He worked as a veterinarian at the Saint Petersburg police dog facility, at the small animal clinic "Vetus", as a teacher at the Saint Petersburg State Veterinary Academy. Oleg Melentev received his degree as a Candidate of Veterinary Sciences on 30.5.2002 in Russia with his thesis (prevention and treatment of dog diseases), specialty 16.00.03 veterinary microbiology, virology, animal epidemiology, mycology, immunology and mycotoxicology. Additionally, Oleg Melentev has received further training, among other things, at the Saint Petersburg State Veterinary Academy in diseases of small domestic animals (dogs and cats). By order of the federal supervisory authority of education and science on 17.02.2010, he was awarded the title of associate professor in bird and fur animal diseases. He has 43 own publications in scientific journals and scientific conference proceedings.
qualification: Oleg Melentev successfully completed from 01.9.2016-20.3.2019 the necessary examinations for the licensing of veterinarians who have completed veterinary degrees in countries outside the European Economic Area, conducted by the University of Helsinki in accordance with the regulations of the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry, as well as evaluation of clinical patient work and the Food Safety Authority. The Food Safety Authority granted him on 5.4.2019 the right to practice veterinary medicine as a licensed veterinarian.
